Hi Samira / Kenji —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap + next steps and a draft Mutual Action Plan attached (Novum_MAP_v1.xlsx). High-level notes from our call: 

- Primary use case: in-product contextual chat for clinical workflows (note routing to private model variants for PHI).
- Key stakeholders: Samira (program lead), Diego (procurement), Kenji (SRE).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 generator latency, < $0.006 per 1K tokens in steady state for the pilot, SSO + audit logging enabled.

Draft MAP highlights (please review):
- Milestone 1: Pilot kickoff (customer test env provisioned) — owner: Jordan (Redwood) / Kenji (Novum) — target: 2026-10-15
- Milestone 2: SSO & audit log verification — owner: Rohan (Redwood SE) / Kenji — target: 2026-10-20
- Milestone 3: Pilot complete & success metrics review — owner: Samira — target: 2026-11-15 (proposed close)

Dependencies called out in v1: SOC 2 evidence delivery, PO/procurement timeline, and Okta SAML test account.

Requests / next steps:
1) Please confirm owners and whether you prefer the target close moved (I put 2026-11-15 as a placeholder).
2) If procurement timelines are longer, suggest a revised close date so I can update the MAP.
3) I propose a 30-min weekly MAP checkpoint (standing invite) starting the week of Oct 5 — agree?

Attachment: Novum_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft milestones + dependencies)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
